approval.source: Owner authorized the numeric qualification limits and 32 claims per release-workload cycle on 2026-10-26, retaining one claim for the focused safety regression. On 2026-10-28 the requester settled 40 cases/minute as the candidate throughput floor; 60/minute remains the offered workload and target.
approval.scope: Candidate qualification thresholds; production activation and release acceptance remain separate.

source_refresh_transaction_boundary: Commit each five-admission source batch before a separate mdm.refresh call
postgres_restart_activation: After every restart, the entity execution role rechecks and reconciles each enabled binding before dispatch resumes; include this step in the 180-second recovery window.
receipt_retention: Retain request keys, canonical request bodies and applied-level receipts throughout the occurrence lifetime and for at least 90 days after it ends; retain coherent backups across that recovery horizon. No automatic pruning is introduced. Keep React's operator retention policy disabled for this profile; if enabling it under a separately approved policy, do not apply cutoffs shorter than the full occurrence lifetime plus 90 days, and retain MDM-owned keys, bodies and receipts for the same horizon.

completed_measurements.name: Exact-current-joint-stack paired 300-case qualification bound to the five-admission source-refresh path and updated profile, including every non-throughput gate
completed_measurements.result: Both candidate and control passed all 32 measured workload checks; release qualification remains open.

completed_measurements.name: Deadline-stratified mixed-backlog fairness probe under the five-admission source-refresh cadence
completed_measurements.result: Candidate 0.108.4 and control 0.108.3 each passed all 33 measured checks; all four 250-case deadline strata passed their per-stratum latency limits. General production-path fairness remains open.

completed_measurements.name: Continuous deadline-ramp mixed-backlog fairness probe under the five-admission source-refresh cadence
completed_measurements.result: Candidate 0.108.4 and control 0.108.3 each passed all 33 measured checks with 1,000 deadlines ramped across 80 seconds; all four 250-case strata passed their p95 and maximum latency limits. This is a harness-only caller-batching diagnostic, not a qualified production intake path; release qualification remains open.

completed_measurements.name: Current-source ARM64 Docker paired qualification with the installed bounded-refresh producer and a 120-second PostgreSQL outage
completed_measurements.result: Candidate and control each passed 34/34 checks at 300 admissions offered near 60/minute with 1,000 simultaneously due cases. Both exceeded the 40/minute floor and stayed within measured outage, recovery, latency and resource limits. Release qualification remains open for a clean, commit-bound candidate wheel with exact-artifact CI/review, candidate restore/clone qualification and 90-day coherent recovery. Customer application adoption of the published v0.49 release is post-release.

completed_measurements.name: Current-source paired candidate/control clean-clone recovery with one pending case
completed_measurements.result: Candidate 0.108.4 and control 0.108.3 each passed all 8 recorded checks. Exact receipt replay, preactivation dispatch blocking, activation rejection controls, one pending-item drain and subsequent healthy worker cycles passed. This is a one-claim safety fixture, not workload-scale clone or production recovery; release qualification remains open.

completed_measurements.name: Exact unpublished producer wheel paired mixed-load outage qualification
completed_measurements.result: Candidate and control installed the same exact wheel SHA-256 5c4c212a3f6205e7d436ee0968ad9ce2e1286cd0ce25881160d4b416665ea3c2 and each passed 34/34 checks with 300 admissions, 1,000 simultaneously due cases, outage, recovery, latency, WAL, writes, memory and storage within the selected profile. Release qualification remains open for final-artifact restore/clone activation, coherent recovery across the 90-day horizon, and final source review/CI/release packaging. Application adoption is post-release.

completed_measurements.name: Exact producer-wheel candidate clean physical-clone recovery, candidate arm only
completed_measurements.result: The candidate arm passed 33/33 checks with the exact unpublished producer wheel, 300 admissions and 1,000 due cases. The physical copy preserved database identity and complete case/receipt state; 1,000 due receipts drained after activation. The matched control was stopped by the host free-space guard before completion, so paired clone qualification remains open. Application images are not clean, commit-bound release artifacts; release qualification remains open.

remaining_measurements: Complete matched exact-wheel clean-clone qualification (the candidate arm passed; the control stopped at the host free-space guard), then qualify restore/clone activation against final clean commit-bound candidate artifacts and coherent backup recovery across the 90-day post-occurrence receipt/key retention horizon
Complete final source review, CI, and v0.49 release packaging; production application adoption of the published release is a post-release rollout item
